findings.detail: Canonical GAV used only Total Investments of 184.466m even though the filing reports Total assets of 254.797m and separately discloses cash equivalents within investments and cash equivalents.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the extracted fund fair value of 184.466m ties to the schedule's Total Investments row, but the filing/companyfacts total-assets anchor is 254.797m. The source also shows Total Investments & Cash Equivalents of 234.264m, confirming the extraction omitted source-disclosed asset value rather than the check relying on an unreadable anchor.
